question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin add built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The source gap is real and feasible, but the fix changes official plugin retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent FTS indexing, and fallback policy, which automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and direct advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior to an external package or ClawHub path.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Document that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval, then close the feature direction.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history, memory-core hybrid ownership, and prior review context on this issue.
